component.name: CanalItem
component.script: function init() as void m.moldura = m.top.findNode("moldura") m.grupo = m.top.findNode("grupo") m.top.observeField("itemContent", "onConteudo") m.top.observeField("focusPercent", "onFoco") m.top.observeField("listHasFocus", "onFoco") end function function onConteudo() as void c = m.top.itemContent if c = invalid then return m.top.findNode("numero").text = c.numero m.top.findNode("nome").text = c.title m.grupo.text = c.grupoTexto m.top.findNode("programa").text = c.programa m.top.findNode("logo").uri = c.hdPosterUrl tem = c.progresso > 0 m.top.findNode("trilho").visible = tem b = m.top.findNode("barra") b.visible = tem b.width = Int(450 * c.progresso) end function function onFoco() as void f = m.top.focusPercent > 0.5 and m.top.listHasFocus m.moldura.visible = f m.grupo.visible = f end function
